overall: Locally verified application controls; residual image and deployment risks remain
scope: Local application and repository security. Deployment assurance and upstream evaluation remain separate.

findings.title: Source intake
findings.detail: Credential filenames and private-key material are rejected before project execution and evidence retention.

findings.title: Local model transport
findings.detail: Model requests reject redirects beyond the approved endpoint.

findings.title: Evidence exports
findings.detail: Archive and decompression limits are checked before reading untrusted bundle contents.

findings.title: Container dependencies
findings.status: Updated tooling; residual OS risks reviewed
findings.detail: Four images have no reported installed/vendored Python advisories; worker npm tooling was updated. Native OS advisories remain, including a critical libxml2 candidate. Dated review expires 2026-11-06; changed or unreviewed findings block CI.

findings.title: Security events
findings.detail: Integrity denials produce sanitized events and repeated-failure alerts; container log retention is bounded.

findings.title: Repository protection
findings.detail: Main requires a pull request, passing CI and resolved conversations. Force pushes and deletion are blocked, including for administrators. Solo-maintainer approval policy applies.

checks.label: Complete combined Python suite with Docker enabled
Focused intake, transport, archive and security-event checks
Image advisory review gate
checks.result: 8 regression tests passed; all four reports reviewed

checks.label: Static and frontend dependency analysis
checks.result: Bandit and npm audit: no reported issues

checks.label: Deployment image, wheel and clean release export
checks.result: Authenticated/read-only smoke checks passed; wheel excludes private/generated data and archives; all 24 recipes reproduced 5 prepared / 19 explicit blockers

limitations: Unfixed native OS libraries remain residual risks. Worker execution requires dedicated, offline, disposable isolation; sensitive or shared public workloads are outside the local assurance scope.
Public HTTPS, host permissions, key rotation, backups and external alert delivery still require deployment verification.
Nineteen upstream preparation blockers, Azure qualification and the 216-run independent campaign remain separate.
